note: Every module extracted or vendored from another Selr product, with the upstream revision it came from. `unchanged` means byte-identical to upstream; `adapted` means the behaviour was kept and the listed changes made. tests/lineage.test.mjs enforces the unchanged entries by checksum.

error wording says bridge operation instead of setup
header comment and usage program name only; every rule is verbatim

a receipt entry keeps extra fields (the bridge stores the reconciliation baseline beside the owned files)

no onboarding, discovery, connections, legacy migration or bundled library
runs as plan operations under the same lock and pending-intent recovery as every other mutation
